items.text: Oracle Technical Consultant specializing in AI-augmented enterprise applications, with expertise across Oracle APEX, Oracle SQL, and PL/SQL. Proven track record designing natural-language-to-SQL reporting assistants and multi-agent AI solutions on Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, alongside custom/standard report modification and OAF-based module enhancement. Combines strong PL/SQL and REST/JSON integration capabilities with applied AI expertise in RAG, LLM fine-tuning, and multi-agent orchestration, delivering end-to-end solutions across Oracle Cloud, Azure, and AWS.

items.heading: Junior AI Engineer — Part-Time
bullets: Trained and deployed YOLOv12 object detection and instance segmentation models achieving 90%+ Precision and 87% Recall across multiple production environments.
Owned the complete ML pipeline end-to-end: data collection, annotation, augmentation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment on real-world industrial datasets.
Integrated deployed models with Arduino-based edge devices, enabling real-time on-device inference at sub-100ms latency in resource-constrained environments.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams in an agile environment to deliver operational AI systems on schedule, supporting internal training programs in detection and segmentation tasks.

items.heading: AI Engineer Intern
bullets: Developed and shipped computer vision models for object detection and segmentation, driving projects from research prototype to live production delivery.
Accelerated model iteration cycles by implementing structured evaluation pipelines, reducing review time and improving deployment readiness for production handoff.
Collaborated with cross-functional AI teams to integrate computer vision models into operational workflows across the full project lifecycle.

items.heading: AI Invoice Automation Agent — Oracle AI Agent Studio
bullets: Designed and built an AI workflow agent that automates supplier invoice intake for Oracle Fusion Cloud Payables: a user uploads a PDF invoice in a chat window, and the invoice is created and validated in Fusion in about one minute, with no manual data entry.
Implemented PDF-to-JSON extraction with reconciliation checks between line amounts and the header total, and separate processing paths for PO and non-PO invoices.
Integrated Fusion REST APIs for supplier, supplier site, PO header and PO line lookups, and for invoice creation and the validateInvoice action; managed agent state with persistent variables.
Developed line matching by description and unit price instead of line order, and automated GL account classification for non-PO lines using a mapping table.
Added human-in-the-loop checkpoints only for ambiguous supplier sites and final approval, keeping accountants in control of judgment calls.

items.heading: AI-Powered NL-to-SQL Assistant — Oracle APEX
bullets: Built an Oracle APEX tool letting non-technical HR users query the database in plain English; translated natural language into safe, read-only Oracle SQL via the Cohere Chat API (command-a-03-2025) and auto-executed it through DBMS SQL.
Constrained generation to a single explicitly defined HR schema, rejecting any request referencing unknown tables or columns, and rendered results as a live formatted HTML report inline in APEX.

Implemented defense-in-depth security: prompt-level restriction to SELECT/WITH statements, prompt-injection guarding, and a server-side guard validating every generated statement’s keyword and regex-scanning for DML/DDL/DCL before execution; all output escaped via APEX ESCAPE.HTML.
Reached 94%+ accuracy on schema-valid SQL generation, a 2s average response time, and zero unsafe query executions reaching the database.

items.heading: Invoice Automation Portal — Oracle APEX
bullets: Architected a full REST-to-database import pipeline pulling live invoices from an external e-invoicing API (Egyptian ETA-style) via Oracle APEX Web Source Modules and REST Data Sources, with credential-store authentication and duplicate-import protection.
Parsed invoice header and line-item JSON with APEX JSON into normalized Oracle tables, and built editable Interactive Grids with full CRUD and lost-update protection for vendor/finance review.
Built an AJAX-driven, one-click invoice submission workflow (custom JavaScript dynamic actions triggering APEX INIT WF) and a hand-built, print-ready HTML/CSS invoice rendering engine.
Designed an executive analytics dashboard with Oracle JET charts (trends, top vendors, top invoices, distribution by vendor) and dual authentication (native APEX accounts + custom EBS SSO).

items.heading: Multi-Agent HR Absence Assistant — Oracle Fusion
bullets: Designed a two-agent orchestrated architecture on Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio: an absence-management agent handling creation/retrieval against Oracle Fusion HCM REST APIs, and a policy RAG agent answering leave-policy questions.
Built pre-validation logic checking an employee’s existing absence records before submission to prevent overlapping or duplicate entries (resolving conflict error ANC-3405005).

Delivered a coordinating orchestration layer routing each query to the correct agent, presenting a single unified conversational interface, and evolved the design to a supervisor/worker pattern for a manager demo.

items.heading: Bilingual RAG System (Arabic/English)
bullets: Architected a production-grade RAG API supporting Arabic and English with 902ms average end-to-end latency via fully async FastAPI and asyncpg, with a provider-agnostic LLM interface supporting OpenAI GPT and Cohere Command-R+.
Designed a dual vector database layer (Qdrant + PgVector HNSW) using a factory pattern, enabling zero-code provider switching through environment configuration alone.
Built a parallelized OCR pipeline (ThreadPoolExecutor + Mistral OCR + Gemini Vision) to process scanned PDFs and mixed Arabic/English documents at scale.
Deployed to Microsoft Azure with CI/CD via GitHub Actions; instrumented 8 Docker Compose services behind Nginx with Prometheus and Grafana for full production observability.
Managed PostgreSQL schema lifecycle with Alembic migrations across three relational tables with JSONB metadata and indexed foreign keys, ensuring efficient chunk retrieval at scale.

items.heading: ArabicLLM — Arabic NLP Fine-Tuning
bullets: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-1.5B on Arabic NLP tasks (NER, summarization, keyword extraction) using LoRA rank 64 via LLaMA-Factory (SFT), matching GPT-4o-level structured output quality at zero per-request inference cost through full self-hosting.
Built a knowledge distillation pipeline using GPT-4o as teacher model to generate high-quality structured training data from raw Arabic news stories, validated with Pydantic v2 schemas.

Deployed a production vLLM 0.6.6 inference server with LoRA adapter hot-loading on an NVIDIA T4 GPU, sustaining 20 concurrent users at 14s average latency at 4096-token context, validated via Locust load testing.
Built a live Streamlit inference UI with real-time token streaming over an OpenAI-compatible API; tracked 3 training epochs at learning rate 2e-4 with Weights & Biases (W&B).
